description: This file defines a routing configuration for a Flutter mobile app using the go_router package. It maps URL paths to specific screens within the app, such as splash, lobby, match, profile, friends, invites, settings, and chat screens.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: A class that provides a static method to build the application's route configuration using go_router.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method that sets up and returns the GoRouter with all the defined routes for the app.
